$schema: Single source of truth per ADR-004. tailwind.config.js imports this file directly; scripts/generate-css-tokens.mjs emits shared/styles/tokens.css from it. Do not hand-edit tailwind.config.js color/radius/shadow values — edit here instead.

interactive._note: Solid brand-600/700 — AA-verified for white text (6.29:1 / 7.90:1). Use for any interactive surface carrying normal-size text (buttons, active nav states, FABs).

decorativeGradient._note: White text on this gradient FAILS WCAG AA at every stop (4.47:1 / 4.23:1 / 3.46:1 — all below the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold). Decorative and large-text-only use (e.g. background-clip:text logo treatment, large hero numerals). Never use as a background behind normal-size interactive text — use color.interactive.primary instead.

responsive._note: Base scale holds from 375px up. At >=1024px, screen-level headers (ScreenTemplate's `header` slot h1) may step up one size (xl -> 2xl) — documented per-screen, not a global override, since not every header needs it.

spacing._note: Inherits Tailwind's default 4px-based scale (0, 0.5=2px, 1=4px, 1.5=6px, 2=8px, 3=12px, 4=16px, 6=24px, 8=32px, ...) unmodified — no project-specific spacing scale exists yet. Documented here explicitly so a future change is a deliberate token edit, not an undocumented drift.

reducedMotion._note: Every animation/transition token above must be neutralized under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) — see glass.css.
